import numpy as np, itertools
WE=W['W_E']; WP=W['W_pos']; WU=W['W_U']
A0=(W['L0.W_Q'][0]@W['L0.W_K'][0].T)/np.sqrt(8); P0=W['L0.W_V'][0]@W['L0.W_O'][0]
A1=(W['L1.W_Q'][0]@W['L1.W_K'][0].T)/np.sqrt(8); P1=W['L1.W_V'][0]@W['L1.W_O'][0]
Xall=np.array(list(itertools.product(range(6),repeat=6)))
def fwd(x):
    E=WE[x]+WP[None,:,:]
    s0=np.einsum('bpd,bjd->bpj',E@A0,E); a0=np.exp(s0-s0.max(2,keepdims=True)); a0/=a0.sum(2,keepdims=True)
    r0=E+np.einsum('bpj,bjd->bd',a0,E@P0)
    q1=r0[:,5]@A1; s1=np.einsum('bd,bjd->bj',q1,r0)
    a1=np.exp(s1-s1.max(1,keepdims=True)); a1/=a1.sum(1,keepdims=True)
    o1=np.einsum('bj,bjd->bd',a1,r0@P1); r1=r0[:,5]+o1
    return dict(E=E,a0=a0,r0=r0,a1=a1,o1=o1,r1=r1,out=r1@WU)
F=fwd(Xall)
print('check', np.abs(F['out']-run(Xall)).max())
dec=F['out'].argmax(1)
print(np.bincount(dec))
